problem:
Problem description
- There is a finite set of crops $$\mathcal{C}$$, indexed by $$c \in \mathcal{C}$$, that can be allocated land on a farm.
- The farm has a land capacity parameter $$L$$ measured in acres.
- Each crop $$c \in \mathcal{C}$$ has a unit profit parameter $$\pi_c$$, measured as profit per acre.
- The planning horizon is a static horizon $$\mathcal{T}$$, and the decision is a one-stage land allocation over that horizon.
- A set of proportional land-allocation rules $$\mathcal{R}$$ may be present; each rule links two crops and specifies a minimum acreage ratio between them.
- The planning goal is to maximize the total profit obtained from allocating acres to crops.

- The total acreage assigned to all crops must not exceed the available land capacity $$L$$.
- The acreage assigned to each crop must be nonnegative.
- Every proportional rule in $$\mathcal{R}$$ must be respected in the land allocation.
- For each rule, the designated left crop must receive at least the specified multiple of the acreage assigned to the designated right crop.
- No additional costs, penalties, or demand requirements are imposed in this instance beyond the stated land-capacity and proportionality rules.
- A solution is represented by:
  - $$x_c$$: the acreage allocated to crop $$c \in \mathcal{C}$$.
  - $$Z$$: the resulting total profit of the allocation.

Input Format
{
  "crops": "Set $$\mathcal{C}$$ of crops, indexed by $$c \in \mathcal{C}$$.",
  "available_land": "Total land capacity $$L$$ in acres.",
  "profit_per_acre": "Profit vector $$\pi$$, where $$\pi_c$$ is the profit per acre for crop $$c \in \mathcal{C}$$.",
  "proportional_rules": "Rule set $$\mathcal{R}$$. Each rule $$r \in \mathcal{R}$$ contains left crop $$i_r \in \mathcal{C}$$, right crop $$j_r \in \mathcal{C}$$, and multiplier $$\beta_r$$ meaning the acreage of $$i_r$$ must be at least $$\beta_r$$ times the acreage of $$j_r$$.",
  "planning_horizon": "Planning horizon $$\mathcal{T}$$ for the allocation problem.",
  "optional_demand_data": "Optional demand data $$d_{c,t}$$, if a generalized extension requires it; not used in this land-allocation instance."
}

Output Format
{
  "acreage_by_crop": "Allocation vector $$x$$ indexed by $$c \in \mathcal{C}$$, where $$x_c$$ is the acreage assigned to crop $$c$$.",
  "total_profit": "Scalar $$Z$$ giving the achieved total profit."
}

Example(s)

Input 1
{
  "crops": ["corn", "wheat", "soybeans", "sorghum"],
  "available_land": 100,
  "profit_per_acre": {
    "corn": 1500,
    "wheat": 1200,
    "soybeans": 1800,
    "sorghum": 1600
  },
  "proportional_rules": [
    {
      "left_crop": "corn",
      "right_crop": "wheat",
      "multiplier": 2
    },
    {
      "left_crop": "soybeans",
      "right_crop": "sorghum",
      "multiplier": 0.5
    },
    {
      "left_crop": "wheat",
      "right_crop": "sorghum",
      "multiplier": 3
    }
  ]
}

parameters.name: num_crops
parameters.description: Number of crops in the finite crop set

parameters.name: unit_profit_per_acre
parameters.description: Unit profit per acre for each crop

parameters.name: left_crop_index
parameters.description: Left crop index for each proportional rule

parameters.name: right_crop_index
parameters.description: Right crop index for each proportional rule

parameters.name: min_acreage_multiplier
parameters.description: Minimum acreage multiplier for each proportional rule

variables.name: total_profit
variables.description: Total profit of the land allocation

constraints.name: land_capacity_limit
constraints.description: Total acreage allocated across all crops cannot exceed available land capacity

constraints.name: proportional_rule_enforcement
constraints.description: For each proportional rule, the acreage of the left crop must be at least the required multiplier times the acreage of the right crop

constraints.name: nonnegative_acreage
constraints.description: No crop acreage may be negative

constraints.name: valid_rule_indices
constraints.description: Each proportional rule references valid crop indices within the crop set

constraints.name: parameter_domain_constraints
constraints.description: Basic parameter validity conditions including nonnegative counts, nonnegative land capacity, nonnegative multipliers, and real-valued profits

constraints.name: planning_horizon_static
constraints.description: The planning horizon is finite and static with no additional time-indexed decision structure used in this instance

constraints.name: total_profit_definition
constraints.description: The total profit variable equals the sum of crop acreages times their unit profits

objectives.name: total_profit_maximization
objectives.description: Maximize the total profit from the land allocation

final_objective.description: Maximize the total profit from the land allocation by maximizing the profit-defining variable Z, which is linked linearly to acreages and per-acre profits.
